newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil retailers started as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil retailers started as a buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it initiated coverage of Brazilian retailers Lojas Arapua and Lojas Renner with a buy rating.
-- It also said its 12-month price target for Arapua is $32.70 and $63.47 for Lojas Renner.
-- Regarding Lojas Arapua, UBS Securities said it believes sales area expansion and greater productivity will provide earnings growth rate of nine percent in dollars.

-- It also said Arapua, a specialty retailer of consumer electronics and appliance in Brazil, trades at 33 percent discount to Latin specialty retailers, while generating more sales per square meter and per employee.
-- "Following the consumption binge unleashed by the success of the Real Plan, Arapua is uniquely positioned to profit from continued consumer demand," it added.
-- Concerning Lojas Renner, it said the stock trades at a 44 percent discount in P/1997E to its peers in Latin America.
-- It also said Lojas Renner has the highest net margin of department stores in the region and compares favorably with specialty stores.
-- Lojas Renner is a chain of 11 department stores in southern Brazil.
-- Lojas Arapua preferred shares were 0.16 percent lower to 19.53 reais at 1640 local/1840 GMT, while Lojas Renner preferred was not traded on the Sao Paulo bourse.
